"""Bind publication helpers once after inspection and before final quality."""

from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V166-common-support-routing-v2'
assert not (root/'train-result-v1.json').exists() and not (root/'scores-v1.json').exists()
paths=[repo/'.cache'/p for p in ['finish-v166-execution-v1.py','publish-v166-final-v1.py','build-v166-final-report-v1.py','verify-v166-publication-v1.py']]
for p in paths:ast.parse(p.read_text())
receipt=root/'publication-helper-preparation-v1.json';assert not receipt.exists()
save(receipt,{'status':'fixed-before-trained-quality','sources':[ref(p) for p in paths],
 'preparer':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0})
allpaths=[Path(v['path']) for v in read(root/'final-helper-preparation-v1.json')['sources']]+paths
assert len(allpaths)==15
output=repo/'docs/results/v166-publication-layout-preparation-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
save(output,{'status':'fixed-before-trained-quality','publication_preparation':ref(receipt),
 'source_texts':[dict(ref(p),text=p.read_text()) for p in allpaths],
 'preparer':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'expected_root_calls':5371,
 'expected_head_images':11452,'expected_owners':15,'expected_rounded_cells':273,'expected_objective_count_cells':60,
 'expected_unit_count_cells':6,'expected_retained_versions':11,'expected_retained_paired_entries':39424,'expected_retained_mean_cells':3256,
 'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,'actual_native_viewing_required':True})
print('Frozen15 final source bodies;5371 roots/11452 images planned including failed prefix')
